features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Scan product barcodes with a camera or handheld scanner to look up and update stock.
user_stories: As a store clerk, I can scan a barcode so that I can instantly see a product's details and stock level.
As a store clerk, I can scan items on delivery so that received stock is added to inventory quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered product, When its barcode is scanned, Then the product details and current quantity display within 1 second.
Given an unknown barcode, When it is scanned, Then the system offers to create a new product record.

features.name: Real-Time Stock Tracking
features.description: Maintain live stock counts that update immediately across all devices after every sale, receipt or adjustment.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can view live stock levels so that I always know what is available on the shelves.
As a store clerk, I can adjust stock with a reason code so that damaged or lost items are recorded accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock change on one device, When it is saved, Then all other connected devices show the new quantity within 2 seconds.
Given a stock adjustment, When it is submitted, Then the change is logged with user, timestamp and reason.

features.name: Low-Stock Alerts and Reordering
features.description: Notify managers when items fall below a reorder threshold and help create purchase orders.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can set reorder thresholds so that I am alerted before products run out.
As a store manager, I can generate a purchase order from low-stock items so that restocking is faster.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product with a threshold of 5, When its quantity drops below 5, Then a low-stock alert is sent to managers.
Given selected low-stock items, When I create a purchase order, Then a draft order is generated for the assigned supplier.

features.name: Inventory Reports and Dashboard
features.description: Provide dashboards and exportable reports on stock value, turnover and movement history.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can view a dashboard of stock value and top sellers so that I can make purchasing decisions.
As a store owner, I can export inventory reports to CSV so that I can share them with my accountant.
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory data exists, When I open the dashboard, Then total stock value and low-stock counts display accurately.
Given a chosen date range, When I click export, Then a CSV of stock movements downloads within 10 seconds.

features.name: User and Role Management
features.description: Allow owners to create staff accounts and control access based on role.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can create staff accounts with roles so that employees only access permitted functions.
As a store owner, I can deactivate a user so that former employees can no longer access the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clerk account, When the clerk tries to open admin settings, Then access is denied.
Given a deactivated user, When they try to log in, Then authentication fails and the attempt is logged.

technologies: Barcode scanning via device camera (ZXing) and USB/Bluetooth scanners

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Stock updates propagate to all connected clients within 2 seconds, and barcode lookups return within 1 second at 50 concurrent users.
All traffic uses TLS 1.2+, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and role-based access control is enforced on every API endpoint.
The system achieves 99.5% monthly uptime, with daily automated backups and a recovery point objective of 24 hours.
A new clerk can complete a barcode scan and stock update after under 15 minutes of training, on screens 360px wide and up.
